notes.title: Hot fix 0.4.0.2
notes.notes:
Another small update containing some changes and fixes

This will probably be the [b]last update for awhile[/b] as we want to work on getting the project converted to UE5 and some more stuff added.

Additions:
New sound effect when under police light
Updated catch meter visual icon to an eye

Fixes:
Stun particle effect now always displays when a player is swiped
Police and players can no longer move around after the game ends
The caught 'eye' indicator no longer fills up before the counter has reached 100
The clocktower's hands now tick for all players
The selected map in the lobby menu now updates for clients who connect after the selection
Host no longer receives multiple post game end screens when playing with others
Tutorial camera is back to normal
stats now register for other maps not just south dock yards
police progress bar is no longer visible after game ends
score board is no longer off center
Railway colliders stop you from going on the tracks

Changes:
Can now see cat hats through walls
Improved light in end screen
Increased size of map select text
Fixed bug where you could see fog and through level geometry in main menu
Removed old fog system from rooftops
Updated player movement and capsule to improve step height
Caught meter is now 0-100
text is now bigger on map select
slightly increased player step height

Thank you all for playing we are keen to see what you guys think!

Check out our Website:
https://www.amythica.com.au

Join the discord to keep up to date:
discord.gg/hptEDSkRpB

notes.title: Hot fix 0.4.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone we've got a bunch of bug fixes and a couple of changes for you guys!!

Changes:
NPC's will now often run away after swiping or being swiped.
Police light timer will now go up slower when further away from police and faster when close to police.
invincible time increased from 4 > 6 seconds
AI crowd the player less
Fixed gamepad not focusing in the host, end menus

Fixes:
Client audio listener FIX
Host can no long pause, mid game, causing very bad desink.
clients can no longer use a controller to navigate to start game and start a match.
pressing multiple swipe buttons on controller will no long make player do a mega dash.
Random map will now be random again, instead of being same map over and over again.
Witchford crossing map is 6.66 percent more spooky.
NAV mesh fixes for WitchFord crossing.
Dizzy effect will trigger more oftern when clients swipe someone (still notfully fixed)
Players will now always get a player colour insead of sometimes being grey.
Railway minor map changes to stop players getting stuck.
Elevators on rofftops mesh has been fixed.
player can no longers see other players counters.
map thumbnails take a bit to load - smaller resolution images to suit size of map selection
fog was too bright on right side of train station, turned down a bit.
fixed problem of seeing out of the map when loading into rail way
player no longer getting caught when invincible after being caught by police
pumpkin king Manor - police spawns wont spawn in the middle of some pumpkins and get stuck on the left side of map in the farm.
number of bots and maps weren't updating and showing for clients on lobby screen.
tree bark material fixed.
tree icons not visible in game anymore.
selected map won't resets when new player joins.
Rooftop Terrace NPC Spawn fixes.
can no longer move in the pause screen.
clients can now alert police by swiping them.
Can no long move when game is paused.

Hope everyone enjoys the fixes, please let us know if you find any bugs :)

notes.title: Organised Crime Update 0.4
notes.notes:
Hey Pocketeers!
We're pleased to announce the latest and biggest update for Pick-a-Pocket so far: "Organised Crime" is now live!
It includes AI Bots, Achievements, Stats, an overhaul to the UI, loads of Bug Fixes, gameplay improvements, visual updates and much more!
Join us with the playtest on Sunday the 14th of July on the official Amythica Discord: https://discord.gg/6jcyUxzyc4
We'll be playing together in the Discord voice channels so make sure to join to get a chance to hang out with the devs!
A little bit on some of the additions:
	⭐UI - The UI has been overhauled to be much smoother and visually consistent. Players should be able to get into games much more quickly with Steam updates and faster loading.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303539/fd21dccfb9e4c2e6b0c9f25efe7e33ebef1affb2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303539/0b3d1f3ff0c167930042418e1011f3b2d5c17d95.png[/img]
	⭐AI Bots - Players can now add up to 7 bots into their game that will compete and add to the chaos of every match online and offline!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303539/f0487c9b5f7425fef0e526714a73da7b1ce78088.png[/img]
	⭐Achievements - 30 Steam achievements have been added to the game! Ranging from "Dodger" (Finished a level without being stunned) to "Bang! Bang!" (Hit by a steam car 50 times).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303539/adcc9224d11da48c42e176e5f2a3efe8642a8a06.png[/img]
	⭐Stats - Keep track of your entire pickpocketing career on the new stats page. This will show how many games you've won, how many times you've been caught by police and much more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303539/44a25cd501ce964ea1169d27107cb5faa7e448d1.png[/img]
	⭐Bugfixes, Gameplay Improvements and Visual updates - We've been hard at work updating every square inch of the game to play much better, more consistently and smoothed out the gameplay experience 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303539/e69939004361918cea8270c190e75ce1def88fd8.png[/img]
Now for the full list of all the amazing things coming in this update:

[i][b]AI Bots [/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Play with up to 7 bots! 
[*] Bots can swipe the players and Marks. 
[*] Bots can also get caught by police. 
[*] Playable in both singleplayer and multiplayer sessions 
[*] Host can add them in the Lobby screen 
[*] Max of 8 players in a lobby. More players will result in being able to select less bots. 
[*] Bots score will be counted on the scoreboard as if they were actuall players. Great for filling out lobbys! 
[*] Bots will strategize and target players or NPC’s! 
[/list]
[i][b]Steam Achievements [/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Chitty Chitty - Hit by a steam car. 
[*] BANG! BANG! - Hit by a steam car 50 times. 
[*] TAAXII! - Rode the cars for 60 seconds total. 
[*] Centurion - Won 100 Games in your career. 
[*] City Tour - Played every level. 
[*] The Knowledge - Played every level 25 times. 
[*] The Ropes - Completed the tutorial. 
[*] The Discordant - Visited Discord. 
[*] You're Knicked! - Caught by the police 10 times in one game. 
[*] Can I have some more? - Stolen over 50g in one swipe. 
[*] Yoink! - Stolen over 100g in one swipe. 
[*] Grand Theft Larceny - Stolen over 150g in one swipe. 
[*] Two Hundred Large - Finished a level with over 200g. 
[*] Three Bags - Finished a level with over 300g. 
[*] The Four Hundred - Finished a level with over 400g. 
[*] Donuts Funded - Lost 1,000g in Bail payments during your career. 
[*] Jam Filled Donuts - Lost 5,000g in Bail payments during your career. 
[*] Gilded Donuts - Lost 50,000g in Bail payments during your career. 
[*] Train the TrAInees - Played a game containing AI. 
[*] Creature Comforts - Stole a total of 1,000g in your career. 
[*] Better get a Safe! - Stole a total of 100,000g in your career. 
[*] Gold Plated HQ - Stole a total of 1,000,000g in your career. 
[*] Dodger - Finished a level without being stunned once. 
[*] 6 Hidden Achievements! 
[/list]
[b][i]Career Stats [/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Keep track of 25 different stats as you play the game! 
[*] Level Records. Including “Richest Night”, “Highest bail paid”, “Most Marks Swiped” and more. 
[*] Lifetime Stats. Including “Total Nights Won”, “Total Gold Lost”, “Total Bail Paid” and more. 
[*] Map Stats. Displays how many times player has won and played each of the maps. 
[/list]
[i][b]In-Game [/b][/i]
[list]
[*] 0.7 second catch meter when in police light. Police no longer catch players instantly. 
[*] ‘?’ Appears when a Bobby starts investigating a noise 
[*] Police can catch multiple players at a time 
[*] Police can send bots to jail 
[*] Text shown when you try to steal from someone with 0g 
[*] Text now displayed above players who are Invincible 
[*] All players now have new colours to be easier to distinguish 
[/list]
[i][b]Map updates [/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Wychford Crossing and Pumpkin King Manor have had their visuals updated to be more detailed and polished 
[*] All maps have had material and mesh improvements for polish 
[*] Player character on main screen is now more fluffy than ever! 
[*] Lobby map has been updated to have more detail in background 
[/list]
[b][i]Interface [/i][/b]
[list]
[*] All menus have been overhauled to be easier to navigate and have cleaner appearance 
[*] Can join players through the Steam friend invite feature (Steam presence) 
[*] Options are now available through Pause menu 
[*] Updated menu level backgrounds 
[*] New button that links to new official Amythica store website 
[*] Options will save automatically now 
[*] Hosts can change maps without having to open separate map screen 
[*] UI completely navigatable with a controller 
[*] Controller no longer loses button focus when clicking on background 
[*] Game no longer attempts to pause in multiplayer 
[/list]
[i][b]Audio [/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Sound audio stutter for clients fixed 
[*] Temporarily disabled npc sound effects to fix bug (will release hotfix to patch asap) 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303539/8a4eabaa22b6351f0eb669dfee526f206c5990a9.png[/img]
Thanks to everyone for your patience while we prepared this update. It's been a while so we hope to increase our communication and speed of updates in the future! That's all for now, check out the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44303539/3465cfa1bb18a651063575ff81f1bc6b39a74088.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Content Update 0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Major Update Alert![/b] Dive into the New World of Pick-A-Pocket! 

Hey Pocketeers!

We're thrilled to introduce the latest major update for Pick-A-Pocket, bringing a host of exciting additions to enhance your thieving experience:

Watch the Trailer here:
[url=https://youtu.be/-GQp4WVDs-A]https://youtu.be/-GQp4WVDs-A
[/url]
[b]Change Log:[/b]
Additions:
[list]
[*] Raccoon Rooftops (map)
[*] Turtle Terrace Lane (map)
[*] Beaver Dam Station (map)
[*] Regent Markets (map)
[*] Westgate Cemetery (map)
[*] Tutorial

notes.title: First Update! (0.1.1.0)
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone!
We're very happy to release our first update for Pick-A-Pocket. This update will include general stability and gameplay improvements based on your amazing feedback so far. 😁


Added:
Black screen with tutorial/controls at start while loading
Can't pickpocket a player with no coins
Police wont send you to jail if you have no coins
Added exit to main (score board)
Animated loading icons

Changes:
Marks - More marks (Cats) at the start of match
Added tutorial and controls screen to start of match
Host screen will now display when connection has succeeded or failed
Game will take you back to the same lobby if Host presses continue
Police and NPC’s should be visible through walls

Fixes:
Online gameplay smoother, players will get stuck less frequently
Players should connect more reliably
Dramatically improved frame rate performance in level
Starting camera will no longer be underwater or appear first person
Host player will now more reliably freeze when stolen from
Extra police wont spawn for players
Players can no longer glide after swiping
All player's start at the same time

Removed:
Leaderboard - removed 1st, 2nd, etc. placement numbers (temporary change)
Continue button for client's (score board)



Thank you all for your patience while we iron out these first bugs and begin adding new features in future updates.
